summary: The assistant connection (MCP) is closed by default, and an update no longer reports a short-lived helper job as not updated.

fixes.title: Assistant connection closed by default
fixes.text: The MCP connection for AI assistants is switched off on every installation. Only a deliberate setting on your installation opens it again. The PIM Manager pages and sign-in are not affected.

fixes.title: Update report without a false alarm
fixes.text: An update no longer reports a short-lived helper job, which the same update creates and removes, as still on the previous version.
